dogecoin.text:
SHIB leads dev takes over

Belfort, who was trying to undermine the asset and its creators, suggested that Shiba Inu as well as Dogecoin were only "jokes". Kusama responded via Twitter.
Dogecoin copycats rose after Tesla's new pet dog, a Shiba Inu, was revealed. SHIB, on the other hand, plummeted after Musk revealed that he doesn't own the meme coin.

Both DOGE and SHIB, as one would expect, are highly speculative cryptocurrencies. They are strongly affected by the short-term sentiment of the market, especially when it is influenced by Elon Musk, a Dogecoin enthusiast.

SHIB, a spinoff mecoin, is known as the "Dogecoin Killer." Dogecoin is a top 20 cryptocurrency. Although it was initially created as a joke. With a market cap of nearly $23 billion, Shiba Inu now ranks among its ranks.
